Exact 135 and 1410 sets, all 5 and 18 orbit representatives/fibers/histograms, and Burnside sums checked. Finite result, finite rigorous exhaustion: no infinite extrapolation, no floating point.

value.rationale: A full symmetry and fiber classification of the facet geometry of a canonical ten-vertex, nine-dimensional transportation norm ball is a natural exact invariant, beyond the known aggregate 1410 count and thirty nearest facets. Five distinct tight-graph types control multiplicities 6/10/14/22, and eighteen nontrivial facet orbits provide reusable structural data for subsequent polytope investigations. Its finite and graph-specific scope is explicit; a different classification, not a routine reexpression of prior total.
